label: Minimum area
subgoals: Divide the required area by the width and round up
Subtract the present length to get the extension

label: Fitting a via array
subgoals: Subtract twice the enclosure from each side of the overlap
Divide by the cut pitch after adding one spacing
Multiply the counts along x and y

Look up the cuts required for that band
Count connections with fewer cuts than required
